description: Validates and replaces the CSS shared by every card of one note type. Defaults to dry-run mode; applying requires expectedDesignHash. Reports applied only after reading back the exact CSS and confirming the Note Type identity and unchanged templates. A write/readback error may follow an applied change; do not blindly retry.

css.description: Complete replacement CSS for the note type

dryRun.description: When true, validate and report the proposed change without modifying Anki

expectedDesignHash.description: Hash returned by get-note-type-design; required when dryRun is false and blocks stale writes

modelName.description: Anki note type name. AnkiConnect calls note types "models" in its API.

name: update-note-type-styling

afterHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the current CSS and card templates

beforeHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the current CSS and card templates

title: Update note type styling
